title: AWS Customer Playbook Framework — S3 Ransomware Response Playbook
scope: AWS Customer Playbook Framework procedure for cloud-native Amazon S3 object encryption/deletion ransomware.

steps.activity: Detect anomalous S3 PutObject/DeleteObject bursts and ransom notes
steps.description: Verify GuardDuty S3 findings, CloudWatch metrics, and ransom text objects in buckets.

source_anchor.quote_or_summary: Verify GuardDuty S3 findings, CloudWatch metrics, and ransom text objects in buckets.

steps.activity: Analyze CloudTrail S3 data events for unrecognized IAM principals or KMS keys
steps.description: Identify attacker IAM ARN, source IP, and external KMS key IDs used to re-encrypt objects.

source_anchor.section: AWS Customer Playbook Framework — S3 Ransomware Response Playbook
source_anchor.quote_or_summary: Identify attacker IAM ARN, source IP, and external KMS key IDs used to re-encrypt objects.

steps.activity: Assess S3 Versioning, Object Lock, and cross-region replication posture
steps.description: Determine whether clean pre-attack object versions exist for recovery.

source_anchor.section: AWS Customer Playbook Framework — S3 Ransomware Response Playbook
source_anchor.quote_or_summary: Determine whether clean pre-attack object versions exist for recovery.

steps.activity: Revoke compromised IAM credentials and apply restrictive bucket deny policy
steps.description: Block attacker IAM principal and prevent further DeleteObjectVersion calls.
steps.condition: Triggered when investigation confirms active compromise or operational impact.

steps.activity: Restore clean S3 object versions and close cloud ransomware incident
steps.description: Execute batch version recovery, verify data integrity, and document lessons learned.
